llm.summary: This skill appears to fetch movie coupon links as advertised, but it also creates a persistent install identifier and sends users to remote coupon links and QR codes with limited safety controls.

dimensions.detail: Runtime access is mostly limited to network calls to the coupon API and formatting returned data; no credential, session, destructive, or broad local-data access was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The README documents installation through an unpinned npx skills add command; no artifact install hook or local privilege escalation behavior was found, but pinning would reduce supply-chain drift.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill has broad activation examples such as generic movie-going intent and instructs agents to present API-returned coupon and QR-code URLs exactly as returned, without clear confirmation, destination validation, or third-party tracking warnings.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The helper script creates scripts/.install_id, persists a UUID, and automatically sends it as the u query parameter for attribution on every API request; README mentions this, but the main skill instructions do not provide opt-out, rotation, or deletion guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core behavior is coherent with the stated purpose: call a movie-coupon API and display coupon URLs and QR-code image URLs for redemption.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. This skill is not destructive, but it depends on a remote coupon API, presents third-party links and QR codes, and may create a persistent anonymous install ID for attribution. Verify destinations before opening links or scanning QR codes, and delete or rotate scripts/.install_id if you do not want stable install-level tracking.
llm.findings:
[RP1] unexpected: Confirmed an unpinned npx install command in README.md. This is an install-supply-chain caution rather than evidence of hidden runtime behavior in the artifact.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: the trigger guidance includes broad movie-ticket intents, which could invoke the coupon/link flow even when the user has not clearly asked for external coupon redemption.
[SQP-2] expected: External coupon links and QR codes are expected for this skill, but the artifact requires raw presentation of remote API-returned URLs and lacks prominent user-facing warnings about third-party destinations, tracking, or changed content.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed: scripts/fetch_coupons.py persists a generated UUID and sends it to the remote API for attribution. The README discloses anonymous attribution parameters, but the behavior is not necessary to simply fetch coupons and lacks user control.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese language and WeChat redemption guidance fit a China-market movie-coupon use case, but the artifact should make that region/platform limitation clearer for users.
